description: No spec subject. Review finding F16 (calibrated severity: Low) from the 2026-08-05 critical review of specled_-0o8. The make xref / CI compile-connected gate sees only what elixirc compiles: lib/ (minus the separately-compiled tracer.ex) plus test/test_support/. The legacy top-level test_support/ is loaded via Code.require_file from test/test_helper.exs, sits outside elixirc_paths, and holds SpecLedEx.FixtureCase and SpecLedEx.IntegrationCase — two of the three case templates, invisible to the gate in every env. Both are clean today (FixtureCase calls SpecLedEx.read_state/2 from a function body only). Could not land on the shipping branch because the real fix is migrating the directory into elixirc_paths; the Code.require_file arrangement is deliberate (test/test_helper.exs:40-42) and 10+ test modules load helpers through it. ADR specled.decision.compile_connected_zero documents the blind spot in the meantime.
title: Compile-connected gate cannot see legacy top-level test_support/ case templates
